Summary 1 confirms the identification, while Summary 2 provides additional specific details with dates (The Beguiling of Merlin: 1872-1877; Pygmalion and the Image series: 1875-1878). To verify this claim, a useful query would target the specific artist-works attribution to confirm or refute the connection between Burne-Jones and these particular pieces, as well as his association with the later Pre-Raphaelite phase.
